supervisor.value: You need a thesis topic and the thesis director's agreement before applying; the director and lab head must give favourable opinions on ADUM

funding.value: Students admitted to the programme get a 3-year salaried public doctoral contract. Contracts are limited and awarded by each doctoral school's competition (file review + audition); every PhD application must include funding or proof of financial means.
funding.quote: PhD students admitted to the Phd program will have a public law doctoral contract. The duration of the contract is 3 years.

also.quote: A first jury of the competition (beginning of June) reviews the applications, and is likely to attribute at most 1/3 of the available doctoral contracts.
A proposed funding or a proof that the material and financial conditions necessary for the successful completion of the doctoral thesis

entry_route.value: Master's degree (or equivalent) required; M1 and M2 results are evaluation criteria
entry_route.quote: The student must hold a Master's degree (or equivalent) and have the agreement of the thesis director. | the results obtained by the candidate in the Master's program (M1 and M2)

notes: Find a topic (ADUM thesis offers), then apply on ADUM to the doctoral school of that topic. Each school examines the file, then holds a short audition (about 15 to 25 minutes depending on the school; EDOM allows videoconference). The page's calendar is for 2024, so check each doctoral school for the 2027 campaign.
